study_strategy.warning: Central Texas Silphium names have shifted. Old S. integrifolium var. asperrimum and var. radulum labels should not be reassigned automatically under modern species concepts.

quick_split: S. radula — rough/scabrous broad leaves and stems, yellow heads, local PASS.
S. laciniatum — huge deeply pinnatifid compass leaves; target-zone HOLD because known Hays occurrence is introduced.
S. integrifolium — broad entire leaves but current-concept local evidence unresolved due historical varietal names; taxonomy/range HOLD.
S. albiflorum — existing white-flowered local anchor.
